title: Deterministic presentation table renderer v1
source_of_truth: tests/fixtures/artifacts/valid/ (existing synthetic artifact bundle; scientific numbers obtained from estimates.json, not hard-coded)
scope: table views sourced from estimates with explicit estimate_id references (markdown render); no figure rendering
gate: presentation provenance binding validation (structure + source_refs non-empty + source artifact exists + item_id exists + canonical source hash current)

cases.A: determinism (same artifacts + manifest, render twice -> identical bytes)
cases.B: source fidelity (rendered values equal the referenced values from estimates.json)
cases.C: upstream change propagation (modify copied estimates.json -> old presentation hash fails; refresh binding -> renders, output changes)
cases.D: manual rendered-output tampering (altered output differs from a fresh deterministic rerender)

no_op: does NOT promote any implementation to tested/verified
